name: Build the real Government Plaza on a native eligible owned plot

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local p=b.CaptiveCapacityPlan(); assert(p.stage=='BUILD_DISTRICT' and p.cityID and p.plot and p.x and p.y and p.occupied==1 and p.capacity==1,'Government Plaza has no eligible owned plot'); b.Queue('BUILD_CAPACITY_DISTRICT'); return 'native district BUILD requested at plot '..p.plot

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BUILD_CAPACITY_DISTRICT' or a=='REJECTED_BUILD_CAPACITY_DISTRICT' then error(a) end; return a=='READY_BUILD_CAPACITY_DISTRICT'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; assert(b.CaptiveCapacityPlan().stage=='DISTRICT_QUEUED','native Government Plaza queue not observed'); b.Queue('PROGRESS_CAPACITY_DISTRICT'); return 'one native district progress request queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_PROGRESS_CAPACITY_DISTRICT' or a=='UNKNOWN_PROGRESS_CAPACITY_DISTRICT' or a=='REJECTED_PROGRESS_CAPACITY_DISTRICT' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_PROGRESS_CAPACITY_DISTRICT'

steps.code: local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_CAPACITY_DISTRICT_PROGRESS')); local o=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.CaptiveCapacityDistrictOutcome(); assert(o.cityID==r.cityID and o.plot==r.plot and o.memberKey==r.memberKey and o.acceptedNonce==r.acceptedNonce and o.occupied==1 and o.captured==1,'native district progress receipt or captive changed'); return o.stage
